item.title: sprintd — via awesome-hackathon
item.description: Hackathon advisory and platform with profiles, sprints, teams, outcomes. Built in Switzerland by members of StartHack, available in Early Access.

item.title: Tulula — via awesome-hackathon
item.description: (discontinued) used to run competitions and hackathons based on an online platform.

item.title: RunCue — via awesome-hackathon
item.description: A remote-controlled countdown for pitch and demo day sessions: the organizer runs the clock from a laptop, the room sees a clean auto-advancing timer, and a private cue warns before each team's time runs out.

item.title: Hackyard — via awesome-hackathon
item.description: (www) - Community-driven AI hackathons for solo builders. Small, capped weekly events where the theme drops at kickoff, everyone builds solo with any AI model, and the community votes with counts hidden until close.

item.title: HackathonHost — via awesome-hackathon
item.description: White-label platform for hackathons and game jams, covering registration, team formation, weighted judging, certificates and post-event analytics. Flat price per event, free for universities.

item.title: HackHQ — via awesome-hackathon
item.description: (www) - All-in-one hackathon and competition platform with built-in registration, submissions, judging, and live results. No account required for participants or judges. Launch your event in 30 minutes.

item.title: Hack-HQ — via awesome-hackathon
item.description: (www) - A curated, community-driven list of open & upcoming hackathons, updated automatically.

item.title: Guides et documentation data.gouv.fr — via awesome-hackathon
item.description: (In French) Documentation for open government data hackathon organizers.
